subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: What scope should satisfy this native-Linux reasoning-latency investigation: a docs/runbook first pass, a live CPX32 reproduction trace, or separate component instrumentation issues?
rationale: The current code already exposes several observability primitives, so the remaining work is choosing the supported measurement environment and acceptance bar rather than applying a single mechanical fix.

options.title: Runbook first
options.body: Document a focused VPS latency-attribution runbook using current metrics/logs and file narrower follow-ups only for measured gaps.

options.title: Live CPX32 trace first
options.body: Require a maintainer-run or delegated live trace on comparable Hetzner hardware before deciding which docs or code changes matter.

options.title: Split by component
options.body: Close this broad analysis into separate context, memory, compaction, Telegram, and gateway instrumentation issues with owners for each path.

recommendation.title: Runbook first
recommendation.body: Document a focused VPS latency-attribution runbook using current metrics/logs and file narrower follow-ups only for measured gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the broadest recent history across docs, VPS/Linux runtime, and adjacent agent runtime surfaces needed to scope the work.
